items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: was kind of like a thrill for me to be there on that set, with Sidney Poitier, Harry Belafonte and-all the names.

ctx.x: And on the lunch break, the caterer -- they bring the food in in a big truck. The food, the canteens come in and then they all sit on these picnic benches for lunch -- and it
was kind of like a thrill for me to be there on that set, with Sidney Poitier, Harry Belafonte and-all the names.

So at lunch break, you get your lunch and you come back to the picnic table. And he came back to the picnic table with me, and we just had a little soft drink and a roll, and he just sit there and put his foot on the stool and was looking at --reading through it. And he said, 'Did you do this?' I said, 'Yeah.' He said, 'You did it by yourself?' I say, 'Yeah, I thought the whole thing out.' He say, 'I like this one,' and I was pleased.
